simple.title: Team Management
simple.description: Create and manage Work teams for your organization.
simple.searchPlaceholder: Team, Team Lead, member or employee ID
simple.noMatchHelp: Try another name or employee ID.
simple.empty: No teams have been created yet.
simple.emptyHelp: Create the first team and choose its members and Team Lead.
simple.editorHelp: Choose where the team belongs, select members and choose the Team Lead.
simple.belongsToHelp: Choose the organization branch this team works under.
simple.ownerLocked: The team location stays fixed after creation. Members and Team Lead can still be changed.
simple.membersHelp: An employee can belong to more than one team.
simple.chooseBranchFirst: Choose where the team belongs first.
simple.noEmployees: No active employees found in this branch.
simple.teamLeadHelp: The Team Lead is a team member who coordinates Work assigned to this team. The lead can be changed at any time.
simple.validation: Enter a team name, choose at least one member and select the Team Lead.
simple.detailHelp: View the Team Lead and current members.
simple.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? It will no longer be available for new Work or Duty. Existing Work and history will remain unchanged.
simple.removedHelp: Restore a team if it is needed again.
simple.noRemovedHelp: Teams you delete will appear here when their history must be preserved.
